title: Fable 5.1 made xhigh and xlow versions of my game
author: sw3d
selftext:
I've been working on a space shmup and wanted to test Fable 5.1 on graphics work. The game has a simple aesthetic by design but I wanted to see what a "xhigh" setting would look like - so I asked Claude to add one. It decided on adding elements like bloom, lightning, shading, etc. Turned out pretty nice, so I asked it to add a "low" setting with an ASCII renderer, and that inspired this fake before/after video XD

Seems like an interesting potential benchmark - how well can a model modulate the appearance of your game in a certain way, it seems everybody is especially trying to level up the look and feel of their game 🤔
